remarks.zh: 计算机柜的板材尺寸。[Width], [Height],[Depth] 是整体尺寸，[BoardThick] 是顶部、底部和侧板的材料厚度，[BackBoardThick] 是背板的材料厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah dan Sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah pengukuran total, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah, dan Sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Latar Belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดบอร์ดสำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height],[Depth] เป็นการวัดทั้งหมด, [BoardThick] เป็นความหนาของวัสดุบอร์ดบน, ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง, [BackBoardThick] เป็นความหนาของวัสดุบอร์ดด้านหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height],[Depth] là kích thước tổng thể, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng trên, dưới và bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng board para sa isang kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] ay kabuuang Sukat, [BoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Itaas, Ibaba at Gilid na Board, [BackBoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Background Board. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: အာရုံစိုက်မှုအဘို့အဘုတ်အရွယ်အစားကိုတွက်ချက်သည်။ [Width], [Height],[Depth] သည်စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာခြင်းဖြစ်ပြီး၊ [BoardThick] သည်ထိပ်၊ အောက်နှင့်ဘေးဘက်ဘုတ်အဖွဲ့စည်းအထူဖြစ်ပြီး၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်ခံဘုတ်အဖွဲ့၏ပစ္စည်းအထူဖြစ်သည်။ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាតួវែងសម្រាប់ទូ។ [Width], [Height],[Depth] គឺការវាស់វែងសរុប, [BoardThick] គឺជាធ្នឹម, បាតនិងវាំងននសាច់កាបូប, [BackBoardThick] គឺជាធ្នឹមសាច់វាំងនន។ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.lo: ຄິດໄລ່ຂະຫນາດສຳລັບຕູ້ເກັບຂອງ. [Width], [Height],[Depth] ຄືການອອກຂະໜາດທັງໝົດ, [BoardThick] ຄືຄວາມໜາຂອງວັດຖຸຂອງຟຼາຍໂຕະ, ຂະໜາດ ແລະດ້ານຂອງໂຕະ, [BackBoardThick] ຄືຄວາມໜາຂອງວາງໂຕະຂອງຄູ້ມ. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ja: キャビネット用の板のサイズを計算します。[Width], [Height],[Depth]は全体寸法、[BoardThick]は上部、下部、側面板の材料厚さ、[BackBoardThick]は背景板の材料厚さです。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ko: 캐비닛 보드 크기를 계산합니다. [Width], [Height],[Depth]는 전체 측정치이며, [BoardThick]는 상단, 하단 및 측면 보드 재료 두께, [BackBoardThick]는 백그라운드 보드 재료 두께입니다. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.es: Calcula los tamaños de las tablas para un gabinete. [Width], [Height],[Depth] es la medición total, [BoardThick] es el grosor del material de la tabla superior, inferior y lateral, [BackBoardThick] es el grosor del material de la tabla trasera. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.fr: Calcule les tailles des planches pour un meuble. [Width], [Height],[Depth] est la mesure totale, [BoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau des planches supérieure, inférieure et latérale, [BackBoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau de la planche arrière. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.de: Berechnet Brettgrößen für einen Schrank. [Width], [Height],[Depth] ist die Gesamtabmessung, [BoardThick] ist die Materialdicke der oberen, unteren und seitlichen Bretter, [BackBoardThick] ist die Materialdicke des Hintergrundbretts. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.hi: कैबिनेट के लिए बोर्ड के आकार की गणना करता है। [Width], [Height],[Depth] कुल माप है, [BoardThick] शीर्ष, नीचे और साइड बोर्ड सामग्री मोटाई है, [BackBoardThick] बैकग्राउंड बोर्ड सामग्री मोटाई है। (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ru: Вычисляет размеры досок для шкафа. [Width], [Height],[Depth] - это общие размеры, [BoardThick] - это толщина материала верхней, нижней и боковой доски, [BackBoardThick] - это толщина материала задней доски. (AI translated, please check)
